releases.title: Gemini 4 Argon
releases.summary: Google's latest frontier model, aimed at hard coding, science and agentic work with a 1M-token limit. Available via API, Antigravity (Ultra), and the Gemini app (Ultra/Pro). Intro price $2/$10 per 1M tokens until Nov 30.

releases.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
releases.summary: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest small model. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads also halved in price, and Max/Team plans get monthly API credits.

releases.title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
releases.summary: GPT-6 Sol (paid) and Luna (Free/Go) arrive in ChatGPT Chat, answering with interactive UIs. Rollout to paid tiers started Oct 7, Free/Go the next day.

releases.title: dots (cloud-computer agents)
releases.summary: Always-on personal agents rolling out in ChatGPT to Pro and Business Premium users in eligible markets.

releases.title: Claude Opus 5.5
releases.summary: First of the Claude 5.5 family: long-running agentic coding and knowledge work, $4/$20 per 1M tokens, 1M context. Fast mode available in Claude Code.

releases.title: Grok 4.7
releases.summary: Flagship for coding and knowledge work; 500k context, $2/$6 per 1M tokens on the API. Available in Cursor and Grok Build.

releases.title: Agents API (public beta)
releases.summary: Brings the Codex harness and infrastructure to developers via API; pay only for tokens and tools used.

releases.title: Muse personal agent
releases.summary: Meta's personal AI agent for everyday tasks, in a Muse app, WhatsApp and the web. Date per secondary coverage; link is AP News.

releases.title: Projects (beta)
releases.summary: A coordinator agent delegates long-running work to cloud subagents; can subscribe to Slack, PRs and schedules. Exact day not confirmed (September per secondary timeline).
